children: Jazz Pharmaceuticals entered into Amendment No. 4 to its Credit Agreement to extend and reprice its U.S. dollar term loan, converting Tranche B-2 into a new $1.895 billion Tranche B-3. The maturity moves to May 5, 2033, and margins drop by 50 bps to 1.75% over Term SOFR (0.75% over prime), with a 0.50% SOFR floor and no credit spread adjustment. Jazz borrowed about $273.3 million of additional Tranche B-3 to repay non-converted B-2 loans. The Tranche B-3 amortizes at 0.25% quarterly, with the balance due at maturity, enhancing flexibility and lowering interest expense.
